_comment: Behavioral defaults seeded into each new User's agentDir/settings.json on first creation (ADR-0001). Edit this file to change defaults for NEW users; existing users keep their seeded copy until re-seeded. defaultProvider/defaultModel are pinned to this deployment's model (match ~/.pi/agent/settings.json); a BYOK User whose own catalog lacks this model gets the SDK fallback (first available). Baseline utility skills (web-search, fetch-url) ARE seeded as a default entitlement — they are safe, generic HTTP tools every user needs. All other entitlement (skills/packages) stays admin-curated per-User (default-deny).
